behavioral_guards: FLAGS_PER_REQUEST=N selects N distinct manifest keys and never repeats a key to inflate the count.
Every configured value opposes the caller default so OpenFeature fallbacks are detectable.
The application returns HTTP 502 when any evaluation errors or mismatches.
The load generator rejects error details, value mismatches, count mismatches, and digest mismatches; an HTTP 200 carrying fallback values is not a success.
Semantic preflight runs before every timed measurement and verifies the expected label, flag count, and spawned process ID.
The validator rejects unknown backends or strategies, a label that disagrees with its backend and strategy, and an invalid provider path.
threaded_batch offloads one unchanged sequential batch; threaded_parallel is optional and separately labelled.
Open-loop rows fail validation when the generator misses its schedule or records semantic or transport failures.
Invalid measurement rows are excluded from report aggregates while remaining validator failures.
The runner refuses invalid matrix values, refuses to overwrite output files, and uses a private temporary directory per run.
The application and microbenchmark share a Flipt-compatible string evaluation context.

scope.benchmark_question: Released Python OpenFeature provider paths in FastAPI using distinct boolean flags.
scope.claim_boundary: Valid for the pinned official Python OpenFeature provider paths and container versions, not every Flipt SDK or a custom adapter.
scope.flagd_inprocess_path: openfeature-provider-flagd file-backed resolver; isolates evaluation cost with no flag-sync overhead
scope.performance_results_note: README.md summarizes repeated same-host 50-flag capacity confirmations as local elimination evidence, not a production capacity ceiling. Raw rows, reports, validation, and metadata remain in the ignored local results directory.
